Implementation plan

1. Files likely to change
- [AUDIT_REPORT.md](AUDIT_REPORT.md) (only writable deliverable)

2. Read-only files to audit (inputs)
- [README.md](README.md)
- [agents.md](agents.md)
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)
- `.github/ai/*.json` (4 files)
- `.github/workflows/*.yml` (28 files)
- `scripts/*.sh` and `scripts/*.py` (34 files)

3. Functions/modules to inspect and use as representative patterns
- [scripts/gh_helpers.sh](scripts/gh_helpers.sh) (`gh_retry`, `gh_retry_to_file`, `gh_api_json_to_file`, `curl_gh_api`, `_safe_gh_jq`) for canonical GH API retry/batching/fail-open behavior.
- [scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh](scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh) (`_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql`, `_fetch_linked_pr_status_graphql`, `ensure_integration_conflict_state_fields`) for batched GraphQL and cache-first loop patterns.
- [scripts/label_helpers.sh](scripts/label_helpers.sh), [scripts/review_rb_judge.sh](scripts/review_rb_judge.sh), [scripts/validate_process.sh](scripts/validate_process.sh) for duplication analysis (`ensure_label_exists` variants).
- [\.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml](.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml) and [\.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml](.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml) for expression-limit history and script extraction decisions.

4. Data structures affected (in report only)
- Define a normalized finding record in `AUDIT_REPORT.md` with:
- `ID`, `File path`, `Line range`, `Severity`, `Category tag`, `Description`, `Recommended fix`
- Section 2 findings additionally include:
- `Current API call count`, `Proposed call count`, `Batching/caching pattern to extend`
- Section 4 findings additionally include:
- `Estimated expression chars`, `Headroom to 21,000`, `Mitigation option`
- Optional suffix `[NEEDS VERIFICATION]` for uncertain findings.
- Build two summary matrices at the end:
- Severity count matrix (with IDs)
- Remediation scope matrix (files touched + effort)

5. API/interface changes
- No runtime API, workflow behavior, schema, env var, or script interface changes.
- Deliverable is documentation-only (`AUDIT_REPORT.md`), plus commit/push of that file.

6. Audit execution sequence
1. Build inventory and baseline counts for workflow/script scope and file sizes.
2. Section 1 sweep: correctness/security checks across all workflows/scripts (quoting, `set -euo pipefail`, error handling, race/TOCTOU, YAML/`if:` logic, secret exposure/injection risk).
3. Section 2 sweep: enumerate all GH API calls and detect per-loop calls, duplicate fetches, missed batching, missed cache reuse, retry issues; quantify current vs proposed call counts.
4. Section 3 sweep: detect duplicated functions/inline blocks/repeated patterns and propose shared helper ownership + caller migration list.
5. Section 4 sweep: estimate `${{ }}` expression sizes only where interpolation exists; flag >15k and >18k; check workflow file size against 800 KB warning threshold.
6. Section 5 sweep: dead code, TODO/FIXME/HACK, consistency drifts, obvious ShellCheck classes.
7. Write `AUDIT_REPORT.md` with required section order and mandatory field completeness for every finding.
8. Validate report integrity: all sections present, IDs stable/unique, summary counts match finding lists, line ranges included, no workflow/script edits.
9. Commit and push only `AUDIT_REPORT.md`.

7. Risks and edge cases to handle in the audit
- False positives from shell static inspection when failure is intentionally fail-open (`|| true`, guarded retries); verify surrounding context before labeling.
- Dynamic shell constructs (`eval`, indirect vars, heredocs) may hide quoting/injection risks; mark uncertain cases `[NEEDS VERIFICATION]`.
- Expression-size estimates are sensitive to multiline interpolation and template expansion; use consistent counting method and report as estimate.
- Large files (notably `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` and `review_autofix.yml`) require targeted symbol/pattern inspection to avoid missing hotspots.
- Duplicate logic may be intentional for bootstrap isolation; classify as tech-debt/consistency unless correctness impact is proven.

8. Testing/verification considerations (for this audit task)
- Confirm only [AUDIT_REPORT.md](AUDIT_REPORT.md) is modified.
- Confirm every finding includes all mandatory fields and allowed category tags.
- Confirm Section 2 findings include call-count delta and batching reference.
- Confirm Section 4 includes both expression-limit and file-size-limit checks.
- Confirm Section 6 severity totals and remediation scope are internally consistent.

Conflict check
- No factual conflict found between issue instructions and repository layout/scope.
